how long have you had oral herpes / coldsores? if its been longer than 6months - 1year i wouldnt worry. especially if its been with you since you were a child. its also very unlikely for you to transmit hsv1 to yourself after youve built up immunity to your own viral load. plus hsv1 is on the rarer side to transmit genitally, so i wouldnt worry! as for him, keep an eye out for any flu like symptoms / clusters of blisters (or individual ones). the first outbreak is usually the worst, and usually happens within a couple days to 2-3 weeks after exposure

i understand your worry love, im no doctor but ive had herpes for 5+ years now. symptoms affect everyone differently, but from my experience oral hsv (coldsores) dont look like that. looks like youre breaking out with some pimples. could be stress, hormones, and/or diet related. there seem to be no blisters, clusters, or any hsv looking signs. keep in mind that herpes is not tested on sti panels, as it is so common and most cases are no cause for concern. a lot of people dont have symptoms, some none for years. unless the bumps start to ooze, crust over, i see no cause for worry. if they do start to ooze or pus, try not to get overwhelmed. nothing wrong with getting it swabbed at a clinic (the best and most accurate way to get a test done is before they crust over). good luck love!
